description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard utility in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing directory permissions and socket path validation.

methods.name: harden parent directory creates directory with0700 permissions
methods.description: Tests that the 'hardenParentDirectory' method creates a parent directory with permissions 0700.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects symlink path
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to remove a socket at a symlink path correctly rejects the operation.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects regular file path
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to remove a non-socket regular file path correctly rejects the operation.
